name: pdfdispatch
description: Make PDFs from HTML, Markdown, web pages and Office files, merge PDFs and take screenshots, through the hosted PDFDispatch MCP server. Includes a skill with print CSS tips and how to save results.

api_key.title: PDFDispatch API key
api_key.description: A key from https://pdfdispatch.com/app/keys (starts with pdd_). Make one just for Claude Code, so you can revoke it alone. Stored in your system's secure storage.
